title: Worldcoin Metaverse
tagline: The project simplifies complexity for users through 3D experiences, offering integrated web assets, non-text-based internet navigation, and visually engaging explanations of concepts like blockchain.
description:
This project aims to simplify complex information for end-users by leveraging 3D experiences. Here's a breakdown of how it achieves this:

Graphical Representation of the World: The project presents a simplified, graphical representation of the real world that users can interact with. It seamlessly integrates both web1-2 (traditional web content) and web3 (decentralized web content) digital assets within this environment. By placing these assets side by side, users can easily navigate between different types of content, bridging the gap between traditional and decentralized web technologies.
Non-Text-Based Internet Experience: Instead of relying on traditional text-based navigation, the project introduces a novel approach where users navigate through 3D scenes. Rather than sifting through directories and subdirectories on websites, users move from one scene to another using simple 3D images. This visual and intuitive method of navigation simplifies the user experience, making it more accessible to a broader audience.
Explaining Blockchain: One of the project's key features is its ability to explain complex concepts like blockchain using simple 3D interconnected scenes. By visualizing how blockchain works through images, interaction, and animation, the project offers an engaging and entertaining alternative to traditional white papers. This approach demystifies blockchain technology, making it easier for users to understand its intricacies.
Overall, this project revolutionizes how users interact with digital content by leveraging immersive 3D experiences to simplify complexity, bridge technological divides, and educate users about advanced concepts like blockchain in an accessible manner.
how_its_made: The communication, UI, UX problem is so sever in blockchain. I started with looking into three.js and webGL to create better UX but realised that creating the 'right look' couldn't be achieved in the command-line. So looked at graphic design software and a creation process from sight. Project uses abode suite and spline 3D.
